properties.description: The primary actor, and the one req:driving-agent names: "The driving agents are coding agents, not humans." A coding agent attached over MCP drives the whole loop — captures intent, runs the detectors, builds, reconciles. req:agent-native ("an agent can drive the whole loop") is its requirement. Recorded 2026-08-07: the Actor type existed with ZERO instances for 24 releases, so every operational view rendered empty and nothing said why. Not a Contributor — a Contributor authors the design; this is who the design SERVES. ON THE actor_type CHOICE, because it is arguable: `user` records the ROLE (it is who reflow2 is for) rather than the NATURE (it is a system). `external_system` would record the nature and lose the point that this is the primary user, which is the whole of req:driving-agent.
properties.name: The driving coding agent
